name: Mobile Checkout Failure
hidden_cause: Mobile checkout completion rate drops 34% due to payment step friction
expected_diagnosis: Mobile checkout friction is the primary driver of revenue decline
expected_evidence: Problem concentrated in mobile checkout step
expected_recommendation: Investigate mobile checkout flow before increasing ad spend
false_diagnoses: Increase advertising spend to recover revenue

detection.criteria: Rev identifies that revenue declined and something changed in conversion or checkout

diagnosis.criteria: Rev correctly identifies mobile checkout as the primary cause, not traffic or product

evidence.criteria: Rev cites desktop stability and mobile deterioration as supporting evidence

prioritization.criteria: Rev does not recommend fixing ads or traffic before fixing checkout

recommendation.criteria: Rev recommends investigating mobile checkout specifically
